_comment: Surgical node-level diff — deliberately NOT a whole-workflow import, because
the repo copy of nem-verify.workflow.json has drifted from live (see runbook).
A full import would clobber live-only changes (Add To Newsletter group ID,
Consent? gate, the current stub prompt).
Apply with validateOnly: true FIRST, read the result, then apply for real.
prompt there verbatim. It must NOT begin with `=`. In the n8n UI the field must
stay in fixed-value mode, not Expression mode. That is the entire point of this fix.
intent: Move the report system prompt out of the JS expression into a Set node so it can contain any character, and lift max_tokens from 1024 to 8000

assignments.name: systemPrompt
assignments.value: TEST MODE. The final NEM Test report system prompt (owned by Alex, stored in Notion) is not installed yet, so do NOT write the real report. Reply in the requested language, under 120 words, headed "TESTRAPPORT / TEST REPORT". State plainly that this is an automated test of the NEM verification pipeline and that the real personalised report will appear here once the final prompt is configured. To prove the data pipeline works, include the first name, primary mechanism, and total score taken from the details below.

operations._comment: Valid? true-branch: Generate Report is displaced by Report Prompt. Respond Confirmed and Mark Consumed stay on the direct fan-out — do not touch them, or the 302 starts waiting on the report chain.

system: reads the Set node. max_tokens 8000. $json.* -> $('Validate Token').first().json.* because Report Prompt upstream rebinds $json. Body text is identical to generate-report.jsonBody.txt, which tests/nem/nem-verify-report-body.test.js evaluates.

updates.parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-4-8', max_tokens: 8000, system: $('Report Prompt').first().json.systemPrompt, messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'Locale: ' + $('Validate Token').first().json.locale + '. Write the full report in ' + ($('Validate Token').first().json.locale === 'en' ? 'English' : 'Dutch') + '.

First name: ' + $('Validate Token').first().json.firstName + '
Gender: ' + $('Validate Token').first().json.gender + '
Age category: ' + $('Validate Token').first().json.ageCategory + '
Relationship status: ' + $('Validate Token').first().json.relationshipStatus + '

Mechanism scores (JSON): ' + $('Validate Token').first().json.scoresJson + '
Primary mechanism: ' + $('Validate Token').first().json.primaryMechanism + '
Secondary mechanism: ' + ($('Validate Token').first().json.secondaryMechanism || 'none') + '
Total score: ' + $('Validate Token').first().json.totalScore } ] }) }}
